name: Sten Stoutarm
summary: Sten Stoutarm is a practical dwarven outfitter and courier stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Responsible for keeping new recruits equipped and managing local dispatches, he helps ensure that novice mountaineers stay warm, fed, and informed despite the harsh mountain conditions.

sections.title: A Helping Hand in the Snow
sections.body: Positioned near the heart of Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm is one of the first friendly faces new dwarven and gnomish recruits encounter outside Anvilmar's tavern. With the valley isolated by winter blizzards and encroaching dangers, Sten takes it upon himself to outfit green apprentices with sturdy gear before they freeze or wander unprepared into the drifts.

sections.title: Keeping the Lines Open
sections.body: Beyond assembling winter outfitting from local wolf hides, Sten serves as an informal postmaster for Coldridge Valley. He handles messages passed through the treacherous Coldridge Pass and distributes official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers throughout the basin, ensuring novice warriors, priests, and mages get their instructions despite the hostile trogg presence blocking the tunnels.

faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm is a dwarven outfitter and messenger stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He assists fresh recruits by supplying warm clothing and delegating local mail deliveries.

faq.q: What role does he play in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Sten serves as both a quartermaster and courier contact for Anvilmar. He collects local resources like wolf meat and pelts to craft protective gear for apprentices, while also routing correspondence and training memoranda across the valley.

faq.q: Why does Sten need mail delivered?
faq.answer: With Coldridge Pass endangered by troggs and winter weather, mail and supplies struggle to flow into the valley. Once messages make it through, Sten relies on dependable novices to deliver parcels and letters to residents such as Talin Keeneye.

faq.q: What does Sten think about the troggs in the valley?
faq.answer: Sten takes a weary, unimpressed view of the pests infesting the surrounding hills, famously remarking that once you have seen one trogg, you have seen them all.

faq.q: Why does he ask for wolf meat?
faq.answer: Sten trades durable, warm gloves to passing adventurers in exchange for tough wolf meat, helping sustain the valley's defenders while outfitting them against the biting Dun Morogh cold.

faq.q: What are the runes and memoranda Sten gives to new adventurers?
faq.answer: They are sealed letters and training tokens dispatched from superiors across Ironforge and Dun Morogh, directing young apprentices to report to their respective class trainers inside Anvilmar.

angles.text: Sten embodies the no-nonsense hospitality of Dun Morogh, making sure his kin are clad in thick leather and fed before sending them into the snow.
As gnomish refugees train alongside dwarves in Anvilmar, Sten treats them with the same practical expectations, dispatching them with mail and outfitting them for the elements.
Maintaining communication through Coldridge Pass is critical for Ironforge's training grounds, and Sten's mail network keeps the valley connected to the wider Alliance.
